name: additional track irregularity
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 由基础变形等传递形成的额外轨道几何偏差。
usage_overview: 通常表示土体变形、路堤冻胀或路基沉降传递到轨道后形成的额外几何激励，用于分析基础变形对系统动力响应的影响；在相应模型中与初始不平顺叠加，形成更新后的激励。

complete_examples.text: The additional track irregularity induced by initial soil deformation is described as the excitation in wheel-rail interaction to depict the influence of soil deformation on VTS dynamic interaction.
As discussed above, the additional deformation of the rail can be regarded as the additional track irregularity to the wheel-rail interaction system.
The TQIs for the superimposed track irregularity (original track irregularity plus additional track irregularity) and the additional irregularity are respectively calculated and displayed in Fig. 16.
The additional track irregularity triggered by the frost heave deformation of the embankment is regarded as the excitation source in the TTDIM to achieve the co-analysis of two sub-models.
The additional track irregularity caused by the frost heave effect of the embankment is considered as the “cosine” shape in the longitudinal direction [40].
